name: The Other Woman
source:
For 28 year old Kaitlin, a busy work schedule leaves little room for romance. This all changes when her socialite roommate brings home a new boyfriend who shows an uncomfortable interest in Kaitlin. Will she be able to fend off his advances?

[From [url=https://arath-sin.itch.io/the-other-woman]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
28岁的凯特琳工作繁忙，几乎没有时间谈恋爱。然而，当热衷社交的室友带回新男友时，一切都变了。这个男人对凯特琳表现出的兴趣，令她十分不自在。她能拒绝他的追求吗？

[摘自[url=https://arath-sin.itch.io/the-other-woman]itch.io[/url]]
